notes: Player cards. Tap any player on the Roster tab: season stats by position, career line, rating by year, honors, traits, and a Mood score with the reasons (starting, in a slump, thinks he should start, eyes on the portal, trusting your promise). Talk to him for 2 hours: clear the air with an unhappy player, lay out a backup's path, challenge a starter, or praise him in front of the team. In the offseason you can move a player to a neighboring position (WR to CB, S to LB, TE to OL and so on) for a 5-point hit he grows back from.
